> **Source:** `webgpu-os/apps/realmforge/construction/RealmForgeGeneratedMechanisms.js`

## Functions

### `realmForgeMechanismBoxesOverlap(a, b, clearance = 0.0001)`

Separating-axis box test; positive clearance ignores touching faces, never rotation.

### `realmForgeMechanismServiceSpans(part, product)`

Conservative world-space tube spans; a bent route's enclosing box contains empty space.

### `composeRealmForgeGeneratedMechanisms(intent, source, { windowPass = false } = {})`

Explicit @2 output only: new data products, paired slot frames, actual hardware and bounded controls.
